title: Junior API Designer
description: Entry-level API designer focused on understanding HTTP protocol standards, applying organizational REST conventions, following API security documentation practices, and generating SDK clients and mock servers from OpenAPI specifications.

skills.rationale: Foundational ability to model resources, apply RFC 7807 error standards, and follow pagination conventions is essential for producing consistent API designs.
Deep understanding of HTTP method semantics, status codes, and URI design principles forms the bedrock of every API design decision.
Following versioning policies, writing documentation per standards, and creating proper changelogs ensures organizational API consistency.
Selecting appropriate auth schemes, following API key policies, and documenting securitySchemes correctly in OpenAPI specifications.
Designing webhook contracts, provisioning mock servers from specs, and generating client SDKs using openapi-generator.
Understanding GraphQL schema governance basics, JSON-RPC specifications, and WebSocket API contract design.
Applying rate limiting quota policies, following pagination standards, and optimizing payloads per organizational guidelines.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in HTTP fundamentals, REST design principles, or API documentation standards.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Basic understanding of REST conventions, but needs guidance on resource modeling, error standardization, and OpenAPI authoring.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Solid HTTP and REST fundamentals, consistent API documentation, and growing familiarity with auth schemes and integration patterns.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all junior expectations: produces well-designed APIs following organizational standards with proper documentation, versioning, and security schemes.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds junior expectations with early mid-level proficiency in alternative protocols, contract testing awareness, and caching strategies.
